scope: Original-data inspection for Hamlar, Jack, Gorn, Diego, Milten and Lester in Ardea; five selected local quests plus the main-story Xardas quest referenced there. This is not a complete regional quest listing.

sourceBuild.dataOrigin: Original installed .info/.quest/.ini data extracted into the completed local study. Native behavior references are reconstructed Ghidra pseudocode, not original C++ source.

browserImplementation.loadedOriginalStartingQuestState: Not established by the static study; no fabricated active/completed starting quests.

languageSource.englishColumn: First semicolon-delimited field after =; following field is the language-specific direction/comment, not another English sentence.

questRecords.title: Talk to the leader of the rebels in Reddock!
Gorn shows you the rebels' hideout.

commands.englishText: Just like old times, huh?
The orcs weren't all that strong. There must be other, tougher ones.
What about Lester, wasn't he going to get some reinforcements?
What are you going to do now?
I will go search for the rebels.
I bet they're not all dead yet.
Show me where the rebels are hiding.
It's not far from here. Follow me.
See, here they are. I knew it.
I really hope the orcs never find this hideout.
Hang in there. See you around.
I can't help it, I don't like orcs.
What's going on with Lester?
He was going to get reinforcements!
My runes have lost their power. I don't think it's any different for the other Fire Mages.
I'm going to set out and try to learn the ancient, true magic.
What are you talking about?
Before there were runes, only a very few, very powerful people could do magic.
That knowledge must be found somewhere. I will seek it.
Bad news! There will be no reinforcements!
So I noticed. What happened?
Go look for the ship. You're not going to find it.
What?
Pirates! It was all over in a moment.
What are you gonna do now?
I'm going to try and make it to the south somehow.
But we'll meet again, surely?
I should think so.
Another fine mess we got ourselves into.
What happened here?
Quite obviously, the orcs have won their war against King Rhobar.
And now the orcs are sweeping through the land, enslaving the humans.
I had a talk with the village elder.
So what do you suggest?
First, we need to get an overview of the mess the orcs have been making.
And one of us must find out where Xardas is hiding.
The necromancer has absorbed the power of Beliar within himself - and he is master of the orcs.
I think you had better take care of Xardas.
And where will we get new equipment now?
But you know how this works.
Collect whatever you can find and don't let anyone take it from you.
And, since the orcs are now the rulers of Myrtana, we will get some fine equipment from them.
What are you going to do now?
You know me. I will be wherever there is something to be had.
Myrtana is now orc territory. But kissing up to orcs just isn't my thing.
I will go south. I bet there are some opportunities left in the vastness of the desert.
Ahoy, matey! Headed for a great adventure?
Nice tower you've got here!
Yeah. It's just right for an old salty dog like me.
But it's a dangerous neighborhood, I tell you.
These bilge rats are everywhere. They don't give an old sea dog a moment's peace.
What bilge rats would those be?
They're roaming the entire coast.
Just walk up the coast a little ways to the northeast.
They set up camp there and they can't wait to cut my throat while I sleep.
I'll take care of your bilge rats.
You know, matey, I've no idea how I could ever make that up to you.
Try and think of something.
You take care of yourself, will you? Those scoundrels are dangerous.
The bilge rats will never bother you again.
Ah, I knew you would help me out, matey.
I don't have a whole lot I can give you, but take this as a reward.
Keep your chin up.
Have you seen any orcs?
Heaven forbid. I hope they have better things to do than scare an old man.
I heard you took gold from the rebels?
Ahem. Yes. I think I can trust you with this.
They were here and asked me to let them know as soon as I see another ship.
I think they're still hopeful that help will come from the sea someday.
Give me the rebels' gold.
Yes, all right. What's an old sailor to do with that much gold?
But promise me you won't squander it.
What have you done? The orcs would have let us live!
Now Xardas will send even more of them after us!
You need to go to Reddock.
What has Xardas got to do with the orcs?
What's wrong with you? Haven't you been here these last few weeks?
Xardas is the leader of the orcs! He betrayed us!
What else do you know about Xardas?
He destroyed the rune magic, that filthy swine!
Deprived of their magic, paladins and Fire Mages never stood a chance against the hordes of orcs.
What's in Reddock?
The rebel camp. It's in the middle of the forest.
Where the wolves are.
I can handle wolves.
Yes, but those beasts are awfully aggressive. And you won't be able to find it by yourself.
I think your buddy Gorn knows where it is. You should go talk to him.
What's up?
Pirates.
Those rotten bastards made off with our treasure.
Looks like it.
We'll have to deal with that later, I'm afraid.
You see, we have a problem.
What problem?
Go talk to the village elder.
But most of all I would like to know what happened to Lester.
You can set out with Gorn.
And what about our equipment?
What do you think? We'll have to get some new stuff.
Talk to Diego. He knows a lot about acquiring things.
Diego is making plans again. Maybe you should talk to him.
What should I tell the rebels?
Tell their leader to send us fighters.
We don't stand a chance by ourselves!
Now we're ALSO in it up to our necks!
Good thing the rebels are here now.
I hope the orcs here will leave us alone for a while longer.
Good luck!
Thanks. We'll meet again.
I'll come with you.
We should search separately. You find Xardas, if anyone knows about magic, he will.
We will meet again. I am sure of it.
So, good luck!

nativeBehaviorReferences.interpretation: RunQuest accepts Open status 0 and requests Running status 1.
SucceedQuest accepts Open or Running and requests Success status 2.

SetStatus shares Success/Won reward behavior and requires previous Open/Running. Effect order is political fame, attribute BaseValue, enclave fame, then GiveXP with world Self/player Other; Ardea_Revolution also activates TUT_AfterFight. Common status assignment and manager notification follow.

OnNPCKilled entry0x2000f90c/body0x203384f0 handles Open/Running/Lost quests and ignores PC_Hero. For quest types2/3/4 it increments every exact matching target-name counter with wrapping32-bit ADD, then calls CheckDeliveryEntitiesStatus when any counter changed. That checker can complete Open/Running quests; Lost completion is rejected by SetStatus. Native task acceptance, original event source and cache remain separate.
FreeEnclave type 10 increments counters for exact matching enclave names. This handler alone does not establish that the enclave became free; the original event producer is required.

CheckDeliveryEntitiesStatus entry0x20025bc6/body0x20338000 handles statuses Open/Running/Lost and types0..8/10/11/12, excluding9. Unsigned32-bit comparisons require every counter to reach its matching amount; an empty target array is satisfied. It requests Won for type12 and Success otherwise; SetStatus accepts both only from Open/Running.
Original item delivery accounting, including directional sender/recipient matching; this is not implemented.
Factory/default invalidation initializes Open status 0. This does not establish the loaded starting-game quest state.
Original area-entry handler retained as a native reference; no browser event routing has been ported.
Manager enclave-event broadcast depends on an original cached quest list whose construction is not reproduced.
Original info-script dispatcher; preserved as a reference, not rewritten.
Original dialogue condition evaluator; source integer condition/state fields are retained without guessing their browser semantics.
Original info execution entry; no original dialogue side effects execute during NPC inspection.
Original dialog-info execution entry; no browser counterpart implemented.
Original info-script-finished callback; no browser counterpart implemented.

preservedDetails: Original spelling is preserved, including event Jack_BanditsThrere and native THF code.
Quest-file rewards and additional dialogue Give/GiveXP commands are separate records; they are never granted by this milestone.
Bare original INI keys are null; blank values and empty command-array slots are retained.
Milten and Lester have no separate quest attached to these Ardea dialogue records. Their later regions are excluded.
Chris_KillDeer is another Ardea-folder quest outside this six-person inspection scope.
NPC inspection does not mark original InfoGiven, fire game events, alter reputation or fabricate completion.
